memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: New diagnosis, symptoms of nasal congestion, sneezing, itchy eyes for 2 months.
  - Plan: Start cetirizine 10 mg at bedtime, fluticasone nasal spray one spray each nostril once daily, montelukast 10 mg at bedtime. Advise avoidance of known allergens, use saline nasal rinse.
- Weight and waist circumference
  - Status: Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cutoff of 90 cm).
  - Plan: Aim for gradual weight loss; monitor monthly.
- Breakfast advice
  - Plan: Include protein-rich breakfast, limit sugary cereals.
- Lunch advice
  - Plan: Balanced meal with vegetables, whole grains, lean protein; avoid fried foods.
- Dinner advice
  - Plan: Light dinner, avoid heavy meals within 2 hours of bedtime.
